ceiling_directive: Extend the dimension-free comparison to the published Loomba–Eckles exposure-action-order class, proving a uniform constant-factor equivalence between the computable linear frontier and unrestricted all-Borel minimax risk.
improvement_directive: Resolve `oeq:prior-rounding` by constructing a genuine bounded-schedule prior with posterior ambiguity at least a universal constant times F for every admissible instance. This would convert the instance-dependent rank/fiber certificate into a sharp generic all-estimator frontier on the same estimand.
critique: The exact identity F=D and the expanded program characterize only assignment-indexed linear rules; unrestricted all-Borel risk remains separated from F by rank or fiber factors that may grow exponentially. Exact all-Borel equality is proved only for the specially constructed additive one-hub l1 body, while the broader hub result supplies rate matching rather than an exact frontier. The reported Loomba–Eckles separation is driven by one high-degree hub inflating a maximum-degree envelope while n-1 essentially independent peripheral units determine the n^{-1} risk, so it does not establish general sharpness failure on a published interference class. The framing correctly leaves the universal comparison and compressed treewidth algorithm open, but those omissions keep the delivered result below a field-level general minimax characterization.
